objective: XAUUSD 1m-60m: does a repeatable short-horizon structure exist that can cover the transaction cost? NOT strategy development.

bounds.inherited_parameters: NO (every threshold below is declared a priori in THIS document; none was carried over from another round and none is fitted to any result)
bounds.declared_threshold_set: one (|z|>=2) plus trailing-regime terciles; no sweep

data.volume_status: DATA_GAP (volume/volume_real/last identically 0) - every flow feature is a quote-based _PROXY
data.bars: 1m bars built from ticks per segment; a bar's close timestamp = the ts of its last tick; the bar is USABLE at that close (PIT)

components.spread: MEASURED (calibration 0.18bp; snapshot median full spread 0.34bp; half-spread charged at entry)
components.slippage: MEASURED signed distribution from the 19-RT pilot; only the unfavourable leg is charged
components.latency: entry signal->fill median ~272ms; reported separately, not double-charged
components.adverse_selection: MEASURED as the execution markout itself, never added again

cost_model.rule: 0.314bp is HISTORICAL_INVALID_FOR_CURRENT_RESEARCH and must not be used

execution_model.entry: first tick with ts > the trigger bar's close ts; long at ask, short at bid
execution_model.exit: mid at the first tick with ts >= entry_ts + h
execution_model.ceiling: HORIZON_CENSORED when the forward window leaves the segment (tick gap > 60s) or the sample ends; excluded and counted

frozen_thresholds.causality: every rolling statistic uses bars up to and including the trigger bar only; regime quantiles are causal trailing quantiles

hypotheses.feature: z5 = ret5 / (sigma_ret20 * sqrt(5)), ret5 = 5-bar return, sigma_ret20 = trailing 20-bar std of 1-bar returns

hypotheses.metric: lag-1..10 autocorrelation of 1m returns with block-bootstrap 95% CI, per session; no trade claim

hypotheses.feature: rv5 = trailing 5-bar std of 1-bar returns; regime = causal trailing q33/q67 of rv5 over 1000 bars
hypotheses.metric: forward |move| and P(switch to HIGH within h) vs the deterministic baseline
hypotheses.hypothesis: volatility EXPANDS after a low-vol regime

hypotheses.metric: after a HIGH rv5 onset, the median number of bars until rv5 falls back below the trailing median (half-life)

hypotheses.feature: onset of HIGH rv5 regime; direction = sign(ret5) of the transition bar
hypotheses.direction: follow sign(ret5) (fade is reported as the mirror)
hypotheses.note: the transition direction is a byproduct of the regime, so the mirror is reported rather than frozen as a separate id

validation.train_test_isolation: time-ordered split at 70% of the sample by event time; no shuffle, no k-fold across time
validation.oos: the final 30% of event time is held out and reported separately
validation.bootstrap: block bootstrap over events, n=2000, 50 blocks
validation.overlap_check: report raw event n, overlap ratio at each horizon, effective_n = greedy non-overlapping count; floor 30
robustness: stability of the sign across IS/OOS and across sub-segments
validation.VALIDATED_EDGE_requires: cost-adjusted positive on IS AND OOS at 1x, permutation p<0.05, bootstrap CI excluding 0, effective_n>=30, sign stable across sub-segments, survives 2x cost
validation.direction_policy: every directional source is reported BOTH ways (follow and fade)
